entries.title: FR-11 Order history view
FR11-TC-01 [positive] own orders are listed with all four fields, and another user's order is not
FR11-TC-02 [positive] a canceled order renders as Đã hủy with the red badge and no cancel button
FR11-TC-08 [positive] a user with zero orders sees the empty state, not an error or a blank panel
FR11-TC-09 [positive] a pending order renders as Chờ xác nhận with the yellow badge and a cancel button
FR11-TC-10 [positive] a confirmed order renders as Đã xác nhận with the indigo badge and a cancel button
FR11-TC-11 [positive] a shipping order renders as Đang giao with the blue badge
FR11-TC-12 [positive] a delivered order renders as Đã giao with the green badge and no cancel button
FR11-TC-13 [edge] all five statuses on screen at once are mutually distinct in colour
FR11-TC-14 [edge] cancel is offered only on the two statuses a customer may still cancel
FR11-TC-16 [edge] the list is deterministically newest-first
FR11-TC-17 [edge] the order date renders as a real date, not Invalid Date or blank
FR11-TC-04 [negative] with no session, the order history is not shown
FR11-TC-05 [negative] a garbage token is rejected and no order history is shown
FR11-TC-03 [negative] one user must not be able to read another user's order by ID
FR11-TC-15 [negative] the order-detail route must also refuse a request with no token
FR11-TC-06 [negative] a nonexistent order ID is reported as not found
FR11-TC-07 [negative] a malformed order ID must not return an order
FR11-BVA-01 [edge] order ID -1, below the lower boundary
FR11-BVA-02 [edge] order ID 0, immediately below the first valid ID
FR11-BVA-03 [edge] order ID 1, the first valid ID, is served
FR11-TC-18 [negative] a non-admin user must not be able to list every order in the system
FR11-TC-19 [negative] a non-admin user must not be able to change an order's status
FR11-TC-22 [negative] a canceled order must not be transitionable to delivered
FR11-TC-23 [negative] an order the user canceled must never display as Đã giao
FR11-TC-24 [negative] a status transition that skips the chain is refused
FR11-TC-25 [negative] an out-of-set status value is refused, so it can never reach the badge renderer
